SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO , MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) as PROCESS_TYPE FROM kep.ICOMIVHD IVHD, kep.ICOMIVDT IVDT, kep.ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVHD.BUYER= 'KRKORE0212' AND ((ivhd.status != 'D' and IVHD.SND_CHK = 'N') or (ivhd.status = 'D' and ivhd.snd_chk = 'Y') or (ivhd.status = 'D' and ivhd.snd_chk = 'N' and trim(ivhd.snd_datm) is not null)) AND IVHD.ADD_DATE >= '20180301' AND IVHD.CHANGE_DATE >= '20180301' AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO= IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' AND TRIM(IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (select 'x' from icomcod1 where type = 'NTIV' and text1 = ivdt.buyer and text2 = ivdt.po_no and text3 = ivdt.po_seq) GROUP BY IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO union all SELECT IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO , MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) as PROCESS_TYPE FROM kep.WMSIVDT IVDT, kep.ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVDT.BUYER= 'KRKORE0212' AND ((IVDT.status != 'D' and IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N') or (IVDT.status = 'D' and IVDT.snd_chk = 'Y') or (ivdt.status = 'D' and ivdt.snd_chk = 'N' and trim(ivdt.snd_datm) is not null)) AND IVDT.ADD_DATE >= '20180301' AND IVDT.CHANGE_DATE >= '20180301' AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' AND TRIM(IVDT.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (select 'x' from icomcod1 where type = 'NTIV' and text1 = ivdt.buyer and text2 = ivdt.po_no and text3 = ivdt.po_seq) GROUP BY IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO ORDER BY PROCESS_TYPE , BUYER , INV_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT Y.LEGACY_INV_NO , to_number(X.INV_SEQ) AS LEGACY_INV_SEQ , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CD , X.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_NM , substrb(X.SPECIFICATION,1,100) AS SPEC , substrb(F_SPLIT(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1),1,32) AS DIMESION , X.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_CD , X.INV_QTY AS ITEM_QTY , X.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , X.ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO , to_number(PRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) as LEGACY_PO_SEQ , Y.INV_NAME AS INV_NM , Y.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE , Y.ADD_DATE AS INV_CRE_DATE , Y.CAR_PERSON_NAME AS TRANSFER_NM , Y.CAR_NO AS TRANS_TRUCK_NO , Y.CAR_PERSON_TEL AS TRANS_PHONE_NO , to_number(Y.IV_MAX_SEQ) AS MAX_INV_SEQ , Y.STATUS as DEL_YN FROM ICOMIVDT X, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ( SELECT IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO , IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS LEGACY_INV_NO , MAX(DECODE(IVDT.INV_SEQ,'000001',IVDT.DESCRIPTION,NULL))|| DECODE(COUNT(*),1,NULL,' 등'||COUNT(*)||'건') AS INV_NAME , MAX(IVHD.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE , MAX(IVHD.INV_DATE) AS INV_DATE , MAX(IVHD.CAR_PERSON_NAME) AS CAR_PERSON_NAME , MAX(IVHD.CAR_NO) AS CAR_NO , MAX(IVHD.CAR_PERSON_TEL) AS CAR_PERSON_TEL , MAX(DECODE(IVHD.STATUS,'D','Y','N')) AS STATUS , MAX(IVDT.INV_SEQ) AS IV_MAX_SEQ FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND IVDT.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO GROUP BY IVHD.BUYER,IVHD.INV_NO,IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) Y WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER AND X.INV_NO = Y.INV_NO AND X.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND X.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND X.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ AND TRIM(Y.LEGACY_INV_NO) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT Y.LEGACY_INV_NO , to_number(X.INV_SEQ) AS LEGACY_INV_SEQ , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CD , X.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_NM , substrb(X.SPECIFICATION,1,100) AS SPEC , substrb(F_SPLIT(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1),1,32) AS DIMESION , X.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_CD , X.INV_QTY AS ITEM_QTY , X.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , X.UNIT_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO , to_number(PRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) as LEGACY_PO_SEQ , Y.INV_NAME AS INV_NM , Y.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE , Y.ADD_DATE AS INV_CRE_DATE , Y.CAR_PERSON_NAME AS TRANSFER_NM , Y.CAR_NO AS TRANS_TRUCK_NO , Y.CAR_PERSON_TEL AS TRANS_PHONE_NO , to_number(Y.IV_MAX_SEQ) AS MAX_INV_SEQ , Y.STATUS as DEL_YN FROM WMSIVDT X, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ( SELECT IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO , IVDT.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS LEGACY_INV_NO , MAX(DECODE(IVDT.INV_SEQ,'000001',IVDT.DESCRIPTION,NULL))|| DECODE(COUNT(*),1,NULL,' 등'||COUNT(*)||'건') AS INV_NAME , MAX(IVDT.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE , MAX(IVDT.INV_DATE) AS INV_DATE , MAX(IVDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME) AS CAR_PERSON_NAME , MAX(IVDT.CAR_NO) AS CAR_NO , MAX(IVDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL) AS CAR_PERSON_TEL , MAX(DECODE(IVDT.STATUS,'D','Y','N')) AS STATUS , MAX(IVDT.INV_SEQ) AS IV_MAX_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND IVDT.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' GROUP BY IVDT.BUYER,IVDT.INV_NO,IVDT.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) Y WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER AND X.INV_NO = Y.INV_NO AND X.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND X.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND X.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ AND TRIM(Y.LEGACY_INV_NO) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LEGACY_INV_NO , LEGACY_INV_SEQ
DECLARE BEGIN IF '$G_RS.PROCESS_TYPE$' = '0' THEN UPDATE kep.icomivhd SET SND_CHK = decode(SND_CHK,'N',decode(status,'D','T','Y'),'Y','T','X') , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO= '$G_RS.INV_NO$'; ELSE UPDATE kep.wmsivdt SET SND_CHK = decode(SND_CHK,'N',decode(status,'D','T','Y'),'Y','T','X') , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO= '$G_RS.INV_NO$'; END IF; END;
